recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Further FHIR-31354 wording changes would duplicate or risk drifting from the already-aligned Bundle.entry.fullUrl definition and Bundle narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-31354 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked to clarify Bundle.entry.fullUrl because batch Bundles with GET/search-style entries can have no entry resource identity to name, and the old POST/operation wording did not clearly list the intended batch or transaction exceptions.
initial_application: The issue was applied in a026c2f242db04aea462f660655cbff949f00026, which replaced the older "fullUrl can be empty on a POST" and unidentified-operation wording in source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml with create, operation, and search/history exception bullets. That initial application covered the ElementDefinition but was later clarified because the wording was ambiguous.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml plus source/bundle/bundle-notes.xml are the current authoritative Bundle sources checked here. FHIR-43106 later clarified the FHIR-31354 application by scoping the exception to batch or transaction request/response Bundles and to create, non-single-resource operation, or search/history cases; c3a11dc9db104fae1e5355ff962f186f09bf4fa2 applied that to Bundle.entry.fullUrl, and 74c0b5c778000e771852a94cadcca2e0aaff2526 reconciled the related narrative and bdl-15 invariant. The linked Zulip discussion and FHIR-I minutes support the approved clarification and did not reveal conflicting later evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Bundle.entry.fullUrl definition already states the corrected FHIR-31354/FHIR-43106 rule, the Bundle narrative points to the same exception list, and stale POST-only wording is absent from the checked Bundle sources.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the ambiguous FHIR-31354 application by scoping the exception to batch or transaction request/response entries and was already represented on the combined branch.
